prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1004; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a left-turn collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle reports being struck by oncoming vehicle while turning left across the opposing lane. Claimant reports a wrist fracture and has been transported to hospital by ambulance. No attorney involved at this time. Initial liability appears disputed pending scene review.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant states the other vehicle was approaching quickly and the insured had already started the turn. Claimant confirmed wrist fracture, currently in a cast, and is not represented by counsel. Advised claimant of the claims process and requested medical authorization forms.

Entry 3: Obtained police report from the responding agency. Report notes both drivers gave conflicting accounts of signal phase. Two independent witnesses identified so far; statements requested. Photos of both vehicles received from the body shop and stored in the file.

Entry 4: Reviewed intersection traffic camera footage available from the city. Footage is partial and does not clearly show the signal state at the moment of impact. Preliminary assessment leans toward shared fault. Reserved rights and notified supervisor for review of liability split.

Entry 5: Claimant called to check status and asked about rental coverage and medical payments. Explained available benefits and sent written summary by mail. Claimant still unrepresented and has not signed a release. Scheduled follow-up after orthopedic evaluation is received.
